Video-Processing Pipeline for Streaming

用于流媒体的视频处理流水线

Designing a Video-Processing Pipeline for a Streaming Service

We talked about video uploads and downloads between users on a messaging application in Chapter 19. To ensure optimal customer experience, there are certain steps we need to take in this video-uploading process, such as compression to reduce the size and transcoding to support different media formats and a wide variety of devices. In this chapter, we’ll focus on building a video-processing pipeline for streaming services like Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and YouTube. As always, we’ll start with the system requirements and then dive into the details of the different steps involved.

我们在第 19 章中谈到了消息应用中用户之间的视频上传和下载。为确保最佳的客户体验，在这个视频上传过程中我们需要采取某些步骤，例如压缩以减小体积，以及转码以支持不同的媒体格式和各种各样的设备。在本章中，我们将聚焦于为 Netflix、Amazon Prime Video 和 YouTube 等流媒体服务构建视频处理流水线（video-processing pipeline）。一如既往，我们从系统需求开始，然后深入探讨所涉及各个步骤的细节。

The main goal of our design decisions throughout the chapter will be for the video content to be available to viewers in the optimal quality and the minimum time possible. We’ll conclude the chapter by deploying the system on the AWS cloud using AWS media services, and we’ll also touch on some considerations for live streaming large-scale events, such as Thursday Night Football in the US and cricket matches in India.

贯穿本章，我们各项设计决策的主要目标都是：让视频内容以最优质量、在尽可能短的时间内呈现给观众。我们将在本章末尾使用 AWS 媒体服务把系统部署到 AWS 云上，并简要谈谈直播大规模事件的一些考虑，例如美国的 Thursday Night Football（周四晚间橄榄球）和印度的板球比赛。

System Requirements

The most important requirement of the system is that the video uploaded from production houses (in the case of Netflix or Amazon Prime Video) or users (in the case of YouTube) should be processed in such a way that it is easily accessible to viewers later. The system design will be applicable to any system involving video processing, but we’ll use examples from Netflix’s system.

系统最重要的需求是：从制片方上传的视频（如 Netflix 或 Amazon Prime Video 的情况）或从用户上传的视频（如 YouTube 的情况），应当经过处理，使其之后能被观众轻松访问。该系统设计适用于任何涉及视频处理的系统，但我们会使用 Netflix 系统中的例子。

There are a few considerations we need to clarify before defining the functional requirements of the system:

在定义系统的功能性需求之前，我们需要澄清几点考虑：

Page 547

Does the system limit the size of the file being uploaded?

There is no hard limit on the file size since video files can be quite large if shot in 4K resolution, so the system doesn’t enforce any size constraints.

对文件大小没有硬性限制，因为如果以 4K 分辨率拍摄，视频文件可能非常大，所以系统不强制任何大小约束。

Should the system be designed keeping live streaming, video on demand (VoD), or both in mind?

We’ll focus the discussion on VoD as the main feature of the video-processing pipeline and spend some time on live streaming in the AWS Day 0 architecture discussion.

我们将把讨论聚焦于 VoD（视频点播），作为视频处理流水线的主要特性，并在 AWS Day 0 架构讨论中花一些时间谈直播。

Can the system support the wide variety of devices that users own, such as Smart TVs, Android phones, iPhones, and tablets?

The system should be able to stream video content to all device types in the most optimal quality possible.

系统应当能够以尽可能最优的质量，向所有类型的设备流式传输视频内容。

Can the system implement different ML and analytics components for recommendations?

The scope of this chapter is limited to not include ML components in the system architecture.

本章范围有限，系统架构中不包含 ML（机器学习）组件。

Let’s talk about the functional and nonfunctional requirements of the system next.

下面我们谈谈系统的功能性需求和非功能性需求。

Functional and Nonfunctional Requirements

Based on the considerations we just covered, we can expect the system to offer the following functional requirements:

基于我们刚才讨论的考虑，我们可以期望系统提供以下功能性需求：

  • The system allows production houses to upload the media content.
    系统允许制片方上传媒体内容。
  • Video should be available to viewers in different formats per their devices and in different qualities per internet connectivity.
    视频应当能按观众设备以不同格式、按网络连接情况以不同质量提供给观众。
  • Videos should be available to viewers in the minimum time possible without too much buffering involved.
    视频应当在尽可能短的时间内提供给观众，且不要有过多缓冲。

Here are the NFRs supported by the system:

下面是系统支持的非功能性需求：

  • Data should be durable—the system shouldn’t lose any data during execution of the video-processing pipeline.
    数据应当持久——在视频处理流水线执行期间，系统不应丢失任何数据。
  • The system should be extensible to support any type of encoding in the future.
    系统应当可扩展，以在未来支持任何类型的编码。
  • Availability is important for the application but not 100% critical. The customers are the production studios uploading the videos, so they can be asked to upload at a later point.
    可用性对应用很重要，但并非 100% 关键。客户是上传视频的制片公司，因此可以请他们稍后再上传。

Let’s talk about system scale next.

下面我们谈谈系统规模。

Page 548

System Scale

The key parameter for system scale is the amount of storage space needed to store the content uploaded by video production houses. Along with the original video files, the system creates replicas of the content in compressed form to support different device types and internet bandwidth availability (we’ll cover more details about the architecture in later sections). The content is further processed by breaking it into smaller chunks, so we should be able to come up with optimal server configurations to deploy the end-to-end infrastructure.

系统规模的关键参数是存储视频制片方上传内容所需的存储空间。除了原始视频文件之外，系统还会以压缩形式创建内容的副本，以支持不同设备类型和不同互联网带宽条件（架构的更多细节我们将在后面小节中介绍）。内容还会被进一步处理，切分成更小的块，因此我们应当能够给出最优的服务器配置，以部署端到端基础设施。

According to Netflix stats, there are more than 18,000 titles on the platform. The number is much larger for platforms like YouTube, where users can upload their own videos. YouTube consists of close to 14 billion videos at the time of this writing, and the number continues to increase year by year. There is one notable difference between YouTube and Netflix: the quality of video uploads. Netflix requires content production houses to upload ultra-high-quality videos, but there is no such enforcement on YouTube. Of course, both platforms have different audiences and use cases.

根据 Netflix 的统计，平台上有超过 18,000 部影片。对于像 YouTube 这样用户可以上传自己视频的平台，这个数字要大得多。在撰写本文时，YouTube 上有近 140 亿个视频，而且这个数字还在逐年增长。YouTube 与 Netflix 之间有一个显著差异：上传视频的质量。Netflix 要求内容制片方上传超高质量的视频，而 YouTube 上没有这种强制要求。当然，两个平台面向不同的受众和用例。

Let’s figure out the storage numbers for our own system based on the assumptions that the system has 30,000 titles and it adds 5,000 new titles every year. The titles can be a combination of movies and TV series (or web series) with multiple episodes. We’ll assume a ratio of 90:10 for movies to TV series, with one series consisting of an average of 10 episodes (there is the possibility of multiple seasons as well). The storage space heavily depends on the type of camera devices used for shooting the video, so we’ll pick an average there:

让我们基于以下假设算出我们自己系统的存储数字：系统有 30,000 部影片，并且每年新增 5,000 部。影片可以是电影和多集电视剧（或网剧）的组合。我们假设电影与电视剧的比例为 90:10，一部电视剧平均包含 10 集（也可能有多季）。存储空间在很大程度上取决于拍摄视频所用摄像设备的类型，因此我们取一个平均值：

  • Total number of videos = 27,000 movies + 3,000 × 10 episodes from series
    视频总数 = 27,000 部电影 + 3,000 × 10 集电视剧
  • Average length of video = 90 minutes
    视频平均时长 = 90 分钟
  • Average size of original video = 50 GB
    原始视频平均大小 = 50 GB

Videos are encoded into different formats to compress them so that they are around a thousand times smaller, contributing to an average size of 50 MB per video. Apart from our main video storage, we need storage for databases to maintain the metadata, such as where the videos are kept in the object storage and other properties related to the content. Of course, the actual video content occupies the major chunk of storage space.

视频被编码成不同格式以进行压缩，使其缩小约一千倍，从而每个视频平均大小为 50 MB。除了主要的视频存储之外，我们还需要数据库存储来维护元数据，例如视频在对象存储中的位置以及与内容相关的其他属性。当然，实际视频内容占据了存储空间的主要部分。

We also need to figure out how frequently the content is accessed from the data storage location. This is important in terms of cloud storage solutions like Amazon S3 where the pricing depends on data transfer rates as well as storage space. For example, Netflix has built a storage wrapper called MezzFS over S3 to reduce download speeds and costs for frequent data access.

我们还需要弄清内容从数据存储位置被访问的频率。对于像 Amazon S3 这样的云存储方案，这一点很重要，因为其定价不仅取决于存储空间，还取决于数据传输量。例如，Netflix 在 S3 之上构建了一个名为 MezzFS 的存储包装器，以降低频繁数据访问的下载速度和成本。

Let’s start with the design of the video-processing pipeline.

下面我们从视频处理流水线的设计开始。

Starting with the Design

The first step in designing our video-processing pipeline (which we’ll call our ingestion system hereafter) is uploading videos created by production houses. A video uploader is a platform for production houses to upload their content and then track progress to know when the content is actually available for viewing. The videos are generally shot with high-quality cameras, which means the file sizes are relatively large. The uploads should be resumable from the client’s end to ensure that the video uploads resume from wherever they left off in case of network issues. This functionality is quite similar to how uploads work on systems like Google Drive.

设计我们视频处理流水线（此后我们称之为摄入系统，ingestion system）的第一步，是上传制片方制作的视频。视频上传器是一个平台，供制片方上传内容并跟踪进度，以了解内容何时真正可观看。视频通常用高质量摄像机拍摄，这意味着文件相对较大。客户端应当支持断点续传，以确保在出现网络问题时，视频上传能从中断处继续。这一功能与 Google Drive 等系统上的上传工作方式非常相似。

Netflix publishes timely engineering blogs to share their architecture and learnings. The content in this chapter is influenced by Netflix’s video-processing blogs; read the blogs for an end-to-end understanding of Netflix’s systems.
Netflix 会及时发布工程博客，分享其架构和经验教训。本章内容受 Netflix 视频处理相关博客的影响；要端到端理解 Netflix 的系统，请阅读这些博客。

The clients are allowed to upload additional metadata along with the source video, such as video thumbnails, video tags, audio tags, and so on. Once the ingestion system has the video, the system runs a video inspection to make sure the video meets the system-defined constraints. If the quality constraints are not met, the production house is asked to reupload the video source files. The inspection is done on the source file by breaking the file into multiple chunks and then inspecting them independently for faster processing, as shown in Figure 20-1.

允许客户端在上传源视频的同时上传额外的元数据，例如视频缩略图、视频标签、音频标签等。一旦摄入系统拿到视频，系统就会运行视频检查，以确保视频满足系统定义的约束。如果不满足质量约束，就要求制片方重新上传视频源文件。检查是对源文件进行的：把文件切分成多个块，然后独立检查这些块以加快处理速度，如图 20-1 所示。

A key consideration you might have also realized here is that the entire system works in asynchronous fashion in a series of steps (steps can be sequential or parallel per the use case). Let’s first identify the key steps in the pipeline and then explore each one:

你可能也已经意识到这里的一个关键考虑：整个系统以异步方式在一系列步骤中工作（步骤可以按用例串行或并行）。下面我们先识别流水线中的关键步骤，然后逐一探讨：

Page 550

Video encoding

To support various kinds of devices and internet bandwidth availability, the video is encoded into different formats and qualities. All of these encoded videos are stored on the servers, and the customers can be served per their requirements.

为支持各种设备和不同互联网带宽条件，视频被编码成不同格式和不同质量。所有这些编码后的视频都存储在服务器上，可以按客户的需求提供服务。

Video-quality validation

Quality validation is done after each step in the pipeline to ensure that viewer experience is not impacted.

在流水线的每一步之后都进行质量验证，以确保观众体验不受影响。

Content indexing

As the content is processed, multiple tasks are done in parallel, such as extracting images to be used as thumbnails later, extracting various content parameters, and creating an index for offering search capability to users.

在内容被处理的同时，会并行执行多项任务，例如抽取稍后用作缩略图的图片、抽取各种内容参数，以及创建索引以向用户提供搜索能力。

Video distribution

The final step is video distribution to users. The video content is cached near user locations using CDNs and served to the users upon request.

最后一步是把视频分发给用户。视频内容使用 CDN 缓存到靠近用户的位置，并在用户请求时提供给用户。

Let’s talk about each of these steps in more detail, starting with video encoding.

下面我们更详细地讨论每一步，从视频编码开始。

Video Encoding

Before we can dig into video encoding, first you need to understand the term codec. Short for compressor/decompressor, codec is a specific algorithm or technique used to compress a video (reducing its size) and later to decompress it when it is actually viewed. We’ll discuss codec in the context of video files, but it’s a general technique and can be applied to any type of file. Some examples of codecs include H.264/Advanced Video Coding (AVC), High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC), and VP9.

在深入视频编码之前，你首先需要理解 codec 这个术语。codec 是 compressor/decompressor（压缩器/解压缩器）的缩写，是一种特定的算法或技术，用于压缩视频（减小其体积），并在实际观看时再将其解压缩。我们会在视频文件的语境下讨论 codec，但它是一种通用技术，可以应用于任何类型的文件。codec 的一些例子包括 H.264/Advanced Video Coding（AVC）、High Efficiency Video Coding（HEVC）和 VP9。

These codecs require a video container (such as .mp4, .avi, .mov, etc.) to host the encoded video. Video container formats can vary from device to device. To ensure that the videos can be played on all types of devices, the system should create copies of the videos in all these formats.

这些 codec 需要一个视频容器（例如 .mp4、.avi、.mov 等）来承载编码后的视频。视频容器格式因设备而异。为确保视频能在所有类型的设备上播放，系统应当以所有这些格式创建视频副本。

Two things apart from format that we need to take into consideration are the video resolution and the bitrate. Bitrate means the number of bits used per second, which helps determine the speed at which chunks can be served on a user’s device from system servers (or CDNs if the content is cached at a nearby location). To take an example of MP4 format, the following are the replicas of the video maintained by the system to serve to customers:

除格式之外，我们还需要考虑两点：视频分辨率和码率（bitrate）。码率指每秒使用的比特数，它有助于决定系统服务器（如果内容缓存在附近位置，则是 CDN）向用户设备提供视频块的速度。以 MP4 格式为例，系统维护以下视频副本以服务客户：

  • High quality (high bitrate): 4K, 1080p, 720p
    高质量（高码率）：4K、1080p、720p
  • Medium quality (medium bitrate): 1080p, 720p, 480p
    中等质量（中码率）：1080p、720p、480p
  • Low quality (low bitrate): 720p, 480p, 360p, 144p
    低质量（低码率）：720p、480p、360p、144p
Page 551

You may have realized that the system needs to perform a lot of work and definitely needs some parallelization in the processing to make it faster. To work in parallel and make the system more efficient, the source video is broken into small chunks after initial inspection of the video. Creating chunks of the video also makes failure handling easy during the encoding process because the system can easily retry for a smaller chunk, but it is resource- and time-consuming to retry for the entire video.

你可能已经意识到，系统需要做大量工作，并且在处理中肯定需要某种并行化来加快速度。为并行工作并提高系统效率，源视频在经过初始检查后会被切分成小块。把视频切成块还使编码过程中的故障处理变得容易，因为系统可以轻松地对较小的块重试，而对整个视频重试则既耗资源又耗时。

Let’s consider what our logic should be for breaking the video into chunks. Should the logic be as simple as dividing the video into 30-second chunks, or do we need some special algorithm to decide the chunk size? Let’s dig a little deeper into this.

让我们思考一下把视频切分成块的逻辑应该是什么。逻辑应该像把视频分成 30 秒一块那样简单吗？还是我们需要某种特殊算法来决定块大小？下面我们稍微深入探讨一下。

For the moment, forget about the encoding pipeline and think of how content is served to the end users. The goal is to serve the best-quality video with the minimum possible bandwidth. Netflix systems employ multiple mechanisms, such as title-based encoding and shot-based encoding, to ensure that maximum-quality videos are served to users at a lower bandwidth usage. Shot-based encoding improves the overall compression efficiency and is a successor to title-based encoding.

暂且忘掉编码流水线，想一想内容是如何提供给终端用户的。目标是用尽可能少的带宽提供最佳质量的视频。Netflix 系统采用多种机制，例如基于标题的编码（title-based encoding）和基于镜头的编码（shot-based encoding），以确保在较低带宽消耗下向用户提供最高质量的视频。基于镜头的编码提高了整体压缩效率，是基于标题编码的后继者。

Once the encoding process is completed for all the video chunks, they are independently validated for video quality, sent for encoding again if validation fails, and finally reassembled to perform the quality checks against the source video, as shown in Figure 20-2. The final encoded video is around one thousand times smaller than the source video.

一旦所有视频块的编码过程完成，就对它们逐一进行视频质量验证；如果验证失败就再次送去编码；最后把它们重新组装起来，对照源视频执行质量检查，如图 20-2 所示。最终编码后的视频比源视频小约一千倍。

The video-encoding system is invoked whenever a new video is uploaded to the system. It can also be used to reencode the video in case more codecs are introduced to support newer devices or some innovation is done in video technology.

每当有新视频上传到系统时，就会调用视频编码系统。如果引入了更多 codec 以支持更新的设备，或者视频技术出现了某种创新，它也可以用于对视频重新编码。

Validations for quality are done at every step in the pipeline, so let’s talk about validation techniques next.

流水线的每一步都会进行质量验证，下面我们谈谈验证技术。

Page 552

Video-Quality Validation

Video-quality validation is done at every step, and appropriate actions are taken to restore the video quality if necessary, but the most important video-validation metric is the rating given by the viewer. This rating is the most actionable metric for passing the video-validation test.

视频质量验证在每一步都会进行，并在必要时采取恰当措施恢复视频质量；但最重要的视频验证指标是观众给出的评分。这个评分是能否通过视频验证测试的最具可操作性的指标。

The validation logic becomes quite important for the encoded videos because these are the final videos used for streaming. The system validates that every generated encoding meets quality expectations. There is a possibility that frame issues were introduced during the parallel chunk encoding, such as incorrect frame boundaries or duplicate or dropped frames.

对于编码后的视频，验证逻辑变得相当重要，因为这些就是用于流式传输的最终视频。系统验证每一种生成的编码都满足质量预期。在并行块编码过程中有可能引入帧问题，例如错误的帧边界、重复帧或丢帧。

After the base validation against the encoded and source video, the system tries to evaluate the viewer’s perception if the video was streamed to the user. Video Multimethod Assessment Fusion (VMAF) is one such validation technique deployed by Netflix. VMAF is a perceptual quality assessment algorithm that generates the quality score from the viewer’s perspective, such as how a user would rate the video while viewing.

在对照编码视频和源视频进行基础验证之后，系统会尝试评估：如果把视频流式传输给用户，观众的观感会如何。Video Multimethod Assessment Fusion（VMAF）就是 Netflix 部署的这样一种验证技术。VMAF 是一种感知质量评估算法，从观众视角生成质量评分，例如用户在观看时会如何给视频打分。

Netflix or any streaming platform wants to ensure optimal viewing experience given the network bandwidth and device constraints. VMAF helps generate quality scores based on all these constraints. Accordingly, we can look for optimizations for further improvements. The whole point of validation at every step of the pipeline is failing fast or detecting issues at the earliest possible moment. This ensures optimal viewer experience and reduces the operational burden on engineers.

Netflix 或任何流媒体平台都希望在给定网络带宽和设备约束下确保最佳观看体验。VMAF 帮助基于所有这些约束生成质量评分。据此，我们可以寻找优化以进一步改进。在流水线每一步都做验证的全部意义在于快速失败（fail fast），即在尽可能早的时刻发现问题。这确保了最佳观众体验，并减轻工程师的运维负担。

The other important factor in quality validation is gathering actual metrics of customer behavior on the device when content is played. The media player running on the customer device captures metrics like times between subsequent delivery of video chunks, error rates, buffer rates, playback start, pause, close, and any custom user actions. These metrics are streamed from the user’s device to the backend analytics system for complete analysis of user behavior and helps fine-tune the quality-control software. The real-time metrics also help us figure out issues with content delivery when the user is streaming a particular video. For example, if there is a high buffer rate on one edge location, then the next set of video chunks are requested from another edge location, which we’ll talk about more in “Content Distribution” on page 532. First, let’s discuss content indexing.

质量验证的另一个重要因素是收集客户在设备上播放内容时实际行为的指标。运行在客户设备上的媒体播放器捕获诸如以下指标：相邻视频块送达之间的时间、错误率、缓冲率、播放开始、暂停、关闭以及任何自定义用户动作。这些指标从用户设备流式传输到后端分析系统，用于对用户行为做完整分析，并帮助调优质量控制软件。实时指标还帮助我们在用户流式播放某个视频时发现内容投递的问题。例如，如果某个边缘位置缓冲率很高，下一组视频块就从另一个边缘位置请求，我们将在第 532 页“内容分发”中更详细地讨论这一点。下面先讨论内容索引。

Content Indexing

The video should be available for user search. Let’s take an example of the movie The Dark Knight: the movie should be reflected in the search results if the customers search via any of the keywords, such as the title itself, the director Christopher Nolan, or any of the actors, like Christian Bale or Heath Ledger. Content indexing is done based on a combination of data provided by the production houses and data generated by the system.

视频应当能被用户搜索到。让我们以电影《黑暗骑士》为例：如果客户通过任何关键词搜索，例如片名本身、导演 Christopher Nolan，或任何演员如 Christian Bale 或 Heath Ledger，这部电影都应当出现在搜索结果中。内容索引是基于制片方提供的数据与系统生成的数据相结合来建立的。

Page 553

The first service that comes to our mind for data indexing is Elasticsearch, which is a great solution when it comes to offering search capabilities. The data should be indexed in Elasticsearch in such a way that users can search via any parameter associated with a video. We discussed Elasticsearch as a solution in Chapters 15 and 18; revisit those chapters to review. In the context of Netflix systems, the search capability is built with Elasticsearch and GraphQL federations, and independent teams can own their own criteria for search.

用于数据索引，我们首先想到的服务是 Elasticsearch，它在提供搜索能力方面是一个很好的解决方案。数据应当以这样一种方式索引到 Elasticsearch 中：用户可以通过与视频相关的任何参数进行搜索。我们在第 15 章和第 18 章讨论过 Elasticsearch 这一方案；请回顾这几章。在 Netflix 系统的语境下，搜索能力是用 Elasticsearch 和 GraphQL 联邦构建的，独立团队可以拥有自己的搜索标准。

Let’s discuss content distribution next.

下面我们讨论内容分发。

Content Distribution

Once the videos are encoded, the video chunks are stored in the object storage, such as Amazon S3, and should be available for user consumption. To ensure that content reaches the audience with minimum latency, the content is distributed to users’ nearby locations via CDNs. Let’s take one step back and discuss storage on the system servers; then, we’ll talk about Netflix’s proprietary CDN solution, Open Connect.

视频一旦编码完成，视频块就存储在对象存储（例如 Amazon S3）中，并应当可供用户消费。为确保内容以最低延迟到达观众，内容通过 CDN 分发到用户附近的位置。让我们退一步，先讨论系统服务器上的存储；然后再谈 Netflix 专有的 CDN 方案 Open Connect。

Let’s think from a user’s standpoint about how the user will receive video streams once they press play for a specific video. The encoded video chunks are stored in S3, but we need some kind of metadata layer to store this mapping that can be used later to figure out the locations of videos. Digital rights management (DRM) protection is added to the video chunks, and then the packaged stream is generated from the video chunks for storage.

让我们从用户的角度思考：当用户为某个特定视频按下播放键后，将如何接收视频流。编码后的视频块存储在 S3 中，但我们需要某种元数据层来存储这个映射，之后可用它来确定视频的位置。视频块会加上数字版权管理（DRM）保护，然后从视频块生成打包后的流用于存储。

DRM protection helps avoid piracy and copyright theft of any type of content. The content is basically encrypted with specific keys, and only the authenticated users can access the content.
DRM 保护有助于避免任何类型内容的盗版和版权盗窃。内容基本上是用特定密钥加密的，只有经过认证的用户才能访问内容。

The videos are also sent to the CDN based on region and past analysis of where the content can be viewed by the users. The CDN locations for the cached video content are maintained in a metadata store, which is useful for serving the user queries at a later point. Netflix heavily uses the Cassandra database for such requirements. Our system doesn’t require any relational database capabilities, so we can choose a NoSQL solution like Cassandra or DynamoDB for easier operations. AWS offers Amazon CloudFront as a CDN offering, and similar capabilities are offered by other cloud providers. Netflix takes it to the next level, moving the data much closer to the viewers by placing the content in the ISP’s location on their devices, which are referred to as Open Connect Appliances (OCAs). Placing content in the ISP’s location benefits both the ISP and Netflix because the bandwidth usage is reduced for fetching the same content over the internet again and again.

视频还会根据区域以及过去对用户在何处观看内容的分析，被发送到 CDN。缓存视频内容的 CDN 位置维护在一个元数据存储中，这在之后服务用户查询时很有用。Netflix 在此类需求上大量使用 Cassandra 数据库。我们的系统不需要任何关系数据库能力，因此可以选择 Cassandra 或 DynamoDB 这样的 NoSQL 方案以简化运维。AWS 提供 Amazon CloudFront 作为 CDN 产品，其他云服务商也提供类似能力。Netflix 把它提升到了新的高度：通过把内容放置在 ISP 处的设备上，让数据离观众更近，这些设备被称为 Open Connect Appliance（OCA）。把内容放在 ISP 处对 ISP 和 Netflix 双方都有利，因为这减少了反复通过互联网获取相同内容所消耗的带宽。

Page 554

There is always a possibility that some users will try to watch rarely accessed movies or TV series, and the content might not be cached on the OCAs in these cases. For these scenarios, the content is moved at that point of time to the user’s nearby location, and the first few frames can take additional time to be visible on the user’s device.

总有可能某些用户会试图观看很少被访问的电影或电视剧，在这些情况下内容可能没有缓存在 OCA 上。对于这些场景，内容会在那一刻被迁移到用户附近的位置，前几帧可能需要额外时间才能在用户设备上显示。

To summarize the overall architecture, the video encoding service pushes the chunks to S3 and the metadata to Cassandra. The cache management service manages the content distribution to OCAs at different locations. From the user’s perspective, once the user clicks the play button for any video, the user’s device connects with the play service to gather the video chunks. The play service determines client details, such as type of device and network conditions, to figure out what type of video chunks should be streamed to the device. The steering service determines the OCAs based on information from the play service and constructs the URLs for the user connections. The user’s device receives these URLs in response and connects with the OCAs to begin video streaming. The client device runs adaptive streaming algorithms to select the best video chunk based on the available network bandwidth. Figure 20-3 shows a high-level view of content distribution by the system and retrieval by the viewers.

总结一下整体架构：视频编码服务把块推送到 S3，把元数据推送到 Cassandra。缓存管理服务管理内容向不同位置 OCA 的分发。从用户的角度看，一旦用户为某个视频点击播放按钮，用户设备就连接到播放服务以获取视频块。播放服务确定客户端细节（例如设备类型和网络状况），以决定应当向设备流式传输哪种类型的视频块。引导服务（steering service）基于播放服务的信息确定 OCA，并为用户连接构造 URL。用户设备在响应中收到这些 URL，连接到 OCA 开始视频流。客户端设备运行自适应流式算法，根据可用网络带宽选择最佳视频块。图 20-3 展示了系统进行内容分发、观众进行内容检索的高层视图。

We’ve discussed the pipeline in parts; now let’s combine all the steps to come up with the final system architecture and its deployment on the AWS cloud.

我们已经分部分讨论了流水线；现在让我们把所有步骤组合起来，得出最终系统架构及其在 AWS 云上的部署。

Launching the System on AWS

At a high level, the system is a combination of steps that are executed in sequence and are dependent on the output of the previous step. We discussed a similar architecture

在高层上，系统是一系列按顺序执行、并依赖上一步输出的步骤的组合。我们讨论过类似的架构

Page 555

in Chapter 15 for the web crawler system; the video-processing system also fits into the criteria of orchestration systems. We can leverage any orchestration frameworks to manage the end-to-end working of the system. Every step in the orchestration cycle is stateless and idempotent, meaning the system doesn’t maintain any state of previous executions and always returns the exact same output for the same input.

（第 15 章中的网页爬虫系统）；视频处理系统也符合编排系统的标准。我们可以利用任何编排框架来管理系统的端到端运行。编排周期中的每一步都是无状态且幂等的，这意味着系统不维护任何先前执行的状态，并且对相同输入总是返回完全相同的输出。

Let’s start the discussion with the Day 0 architecture.

我们从 Day 0 架构开始讨论。

Day 0 Architecture

In Part II, we explored multiple AWS services that can meet customers’ requirements for different business use cases. As always, we’ll try to use fully managed AWS services to launch the system quickly, so let’s figure out which services would be helpful in the different steps of the pipeline for our streaming service. To manage the end-to-end orchestration, we can leverage AWS Step Functions as discussed in Chapter 12, and the storage requirements can be fulfilled by S3 and DynamoDB.

在第二部分中，我们探讨了多种 AWS 服务，它们可以满足客户在不同业务用例下的需求。一如既往，我们将尽量使用全托管的 AWS 服务来快速启动系统，因此让我们看看哪些服务对流式服务流水线的不同步骤有帮助。要管理端到端编排，我们可以像第 12 章讨论的那样利用 AWS Step Functions，存储需求则由 S3 和 DynamoDB 满足。

We’ve used DynamoDB extensively in Part III for storage requirements since it fits into most of the use cases. In most of the scenarios, multiple databases can fulfill the use case, and we recommend checking out other offerings as well (such as Amazon Keyspaces) based on your expertise.
在第三部分中，我们在存储需求上大量使用了 DynamoDB，因为它适合大多数用例。在大多数场景下，多种数据库都能满足用例；我们建议你根据自己的经验也看看其他产品（例如 Amazon Keyspaces）。

AWS offers multiple services to support live video streaming, and the most important service for building a video-processing pipeline is AWS Elemental MediaConvert. This service converts source video into multiple formats and makes them available for streaming on different kinds of devices—a core video-encoding task. Elemental MediaConvert takes input as source video, encodes the video into different formats, and stores the encoded videos to S3. For faster streaming, we can leverage Amazon CloudFront as a CDN solution to store videos near users’ locations.

AWS 提供多种服务来支持直播视频流，而构建视频处理流水线最重要的服务是 AWS Elemental MediaConvert。该服务把源视频转换成多种格式，使其能在不同类型的设备上流式传输——这是一项核心视频编码任务。Elemental MediaConvert 以源视频作为输入，把视频编码成不同格式，并把编码后的视频存储到 S3。为更快地流式传输，我们可以利用 Amazon CloudFront 作为 CDN 方案，把视频存储在靠近用户的位置。

To elaborate on the overall architecture, shown in Figure 20-4, the video upload system supports video uploading from users and stores videos in S3. Elemental MediaConvert takes videos from S3, converts them into different formats, and again stores the encoded videos to S3. To ensure that content is made available to users based on their locations and interests, the cache management service pushes the content to CloudFront. The entire encoding pipeline is managed by Step Functions, and we’ll leverage DynamoDB for metadata storage.

整体架构如图 20-4 所示：视频上传系统支持用户上传视频，并把视频存储在 S3 中。Elemental MediaConvert 从 S3 取出视频，把它们转换成不同格式，再把编码后的视频存储回 S3。为确保根据用户位置和兴趣向其提供内容，缓存管理服务把内容推送到 CloudFront。整个编码流水线由 Step Functions 管理，元数据存储则利用 DynamoDB。

Page 556

We discussed DRM protection in “Content Distribution” on page 532 and why it’s critical for video-streaming services. AWS Elemental MediaPackage services can help with protecting content and distributing it to CloudFront.

我们在第 532 页“内容分发”中讨论了 DRM 保护，以及它为何对流式视频服务至关重要。AWS Elemental MediaPackage 服务可以帮助保护内容并将其分发到 CloudFront。

Now, let’s look at the architecture for managing live streaming events with AWS managed services. The video is uploaded directly from the video production sources using AWS Elemental MediaLive. As mentioned, video content produced from high-quality cameras consumes a lot of storage space, and it can take a long time to upload such videos for distribution. The latency is critical in the case of live streaming, and the upload time should be as minimal as possible (Amazon Prime Video targets less than 10 seconds of latency for streaming Thursday Night Football). Elemental MediaLive plays a critical role in achieving low latency and offers video encoding and compression at the source. The high-quality video content is encoded at the source in real time and then uploaded to the cloud for further processing and distribution.

现在我们看看用 AWS 托管服务管理直播事件的架构。视频使用 AWS Elemental MediaLive 直接从视频制作源上传。如前所述，高质量摄像机制作的视频内容会消耗大量存储空间，上传这类视频用于分发可能需要很长时间。在直播场景下，延迟至关重要，上传时间应尽可能短（Amazon Prime Video 对 Thursday Night Football 流的目标是延迟低于 10 秒）。Elemental MediaLive 在实现低延迟方面扮演关键角色，并在源端提供视频编码和压缩。高质量视频内容在源端实时编码，然后上传到云端以做进一步处理和分发。

The next technology used for faster uploads is AWS Direct Connect, which ensures that the video streams are uploaded via the AWS global network and don’t face the congestion challenges of the public internet. Visit Chapter 9 to refresh your understanding of Direct Connect and similar networking services.

用于更快上传的下一项技术是 AWS Direct Connect，它确保视频流通过 AWS 全球网络上传，不会面临公网的拥塞问题。请参阅第 9 章，重温你对 Direct Connect 及类似网络服务的理解。

Once the video stream reaches the AWS cloud, it is consumed by Elemental MediaPackage for content protection and delivery. MediaPackage helps with manifest creation of the video, content protection via DRM such as Google Widevine and Microsoft PlayReady, and content consumption per the device type, such as HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) for Apple devices and MPEG-DASH for Android devices. The content is stored to S3 as origin and then distributed via the CloudFront service to the end viewers. The architecture with live streaming using AWS services is shown in Figure 20-5.

视频流一旦到达 AWS 云，就由 Elemental MediaPackage 消费，用于内容保护和投递。MediaPackage 帮助生成视频的清单（manifest）、通过 Google Widevine 和 Microsoft PlayReady 等 DRM 保护内容，并按设备类型提供内容消费方式，例如 Apple 设备用 HTTP Live Streaming（HLS），Android 设备用 MPEG-DASH。内容作为源站存储到 S3，然后通过 CloudFront 服务分发给终端观众。使用 AWS 服务进行直播的架构如图 20-5 所示。

Page 557

In Figure 20-5, we used S3 as a video storage solution. AWS offers the Elemental MediaStore service, which is specifically designed and optimized to store media content and serve the live content with low latency.

在图 20-5 中，我们使用 S3 作为视频存储方案。AWS 提供 Elemental MediaStore 服务，它是专门为存储媒体内容、并以低延迟提供直播内容而设计和优化的。

Now, let’s scale the Day 0 architecture of the video-processing pipeline.

现在，我们来扩展视频处理流水线的 Day 0 架构。

Scaling to Millions and Beyond

The most important parameter for scaling the video-processing pipeline is execution time. The system should be able to encode and validate the videos in the minimum possible time and make the videos available for streaming to different device types. Let’s start with the uppermost layer of the architecture shown in Figure 20-4. We already discussed the scalability of AWS Step Functions in Chapter 15; it doesn’t present any specific bottleneck in scaling. The only point of consideration here is cost. Step Functions pricing is based on the number of state transitions and the type of Step Function (more details are provided in Chapter 12), and the cost can grow significantly as the amount of content being loaded onto the system increases over time. Start with Step Functions to get retries and better debugging capabilities out of the box; later, you can evaluate whether you need a custom orchestration workflow engine.

扩展视频处理流水线最重要的参数是执行时间。系统应当能够在尽可能短的时间内编码并验证视频，使视频可流式传输到不同设备类型。我们从图 20-4 所示架构的最上层开始。我们在第 15 章已经讨论过 AWS Step Functions 的可扩展性；它在扩展方面不构成任何特定瓶颈。这里唯一要考虑的是成本。Step Functions 的定价基于状态转换次数和 Step Function 的类型（更多细节见第 12 章），随着加载到系统中的内容量随时间增长，成本可能显著上升。先从 Step Functions 开始，开箱即用地获得重试和更好的调试能力；之后你可以评估是否需要一个自定义的编排工作流引擎。

Another managed service we used in the architecture is Elemental MediaConvert for video encoding. It is designed to operate at high scale, and there are no limits enforced by AWS, but the consideration here is control needed for operations. It is a great solution to start with, but you’re dependent on AWS for encoding decisions. We discussed in previous sections that the video chunk size is not fixed but is optimized based on the video type, and the case of running validations is similar. Keeping this in house helps you fully control the implementation logic and removes the dependency on AWS services.

我们在架构中使用的另一个托管服务是用于视频编码的 Elemental MediaConvert。它被设计为高规模运行，AWS 不强制任何限制，但这里要考虑的是运维所需的控制权。它作为起步是一个很好的方案，但在编码决策上你会依赖 AWS。我们在前面几节讨论过，视频块大小不是固定的，而是根据视频类型优化的；运行验证的情况也类似。把这部分留在自建中，能帮助你完全控制实现逻辑，并消除对 AWS 服务的依赖。

We broke down the video-processing pipeline into a series of steps in “Starting with the Design” on page 528. All these steps are executed by independent microservices. This ensures that the services can be scaled and bring in innovation without affecting or blocking other components. We can take a reference from the Netflix architecture for dividing components based on the operations. The following is a list of services, each responsible for a specific set of tasks:

我们在第 528 页“从设计开始”中把视频处理流水线分解成了一系列步骤。所有这些步骤都由独立的微服务执行。这确保各服务可以独立扩展和创新，而不会影响或阻塞其他组件。我们可以参考 Netflix 架构，按操作来划分组件。下面是一份服务清单，每个服务负责一组特定任务：

Page 558

Video upload service

This service handles the video uploads from the content production houses and persists them to S3.

该服务处理来自内容制片方的视频上传，并将其持久化到 S3。

Video inspection service

This service breaks the videos received from the production houses into chunks, inspects the chunks, and flags any issues. This service also extracts metadata from the video chunks, which is used in later stages of the pipeline.

该服务把从制片方收到的视频切分成块，检查这些块，并标记任何问题。该服务还从视频块中提取元数据，供流水线后续阶段使用。

Complexity analysis service

This service runs analysis on the source video to figure out the optimal encoding recipe. It also communicates with the video encoding and quality services for preencoding and quality operations, respectively. The results of the encoding and quality services are persisted so that they can be used in later stages of the pipeline.

该服务对源视频运行分析，以找出最优编码配方（recipe）。它还分别与视频编码服务和质量服务通信，进行预编码和质量操作。编码服务和质量服务的结果会被持久化，以便在流水线后续阶段使用。

Ladder generation service

This service receives the complexity data from the complexity analysis service and creates a bitrate ladder for a given encoding family (H.264, AV1, etc.). The complexity analysis and ladder generation services work together to generate the final encoding recipes, which are later used by the video encoding service.

该服务从复杂度分析服务接收复杂度数据，并为给定编码家族（H.264、AV1 等）创建码率阶梯（bitrate ladder）。复杂度分析服务和阶梯生成服务协同工作，生成最终编码配方，供视频编码服务之后使用。

Video encoding service

This service takes the source video and encoding recipes as input and generates encoded video in the output.

该服务以源视频和编码配方作为输入，输出编码后的视频。

Video validation service

This service runs validations on the encoded video. The validation is done based on expectations specified against the video, such as attributes in the encoding recipe and conformance requirements from the codec specification. Conformance in terms of codec means whether the codec meets defined standards or not.

该服务对编码后的视频运行验证。验证是基于针对视频指定的期望进行的，例如编码配方中的属性以及来自 codec 规范的一致性要求。就 codec 而言，一致性指 codec 是否满足已定义的标准。

Video quality service

This service computes quality scores (VMAF) by comparing the source video and the encoded video.

该服务通过比较源视频和编码视频来计算质量评分（VMAF）。

All the services are shown in Figure 20-6. They are managed by a workflow orchestrator for their operations. The workflow orchestrator (such as Netflix Conductor and Maestro) sends the required input to a specific service and gathers the output to pass it along to other services in the needed format. The output can be as simple as small metadata or it can be a large file, and accordingly, the workflow orchestrator can decide how the data is shared to other services. For example, the large file can be dumped to S3, and the URL can be shared to the corresponding service.

所有服务如图 20-6 所示。它们由一个工作流编排器管理其运行。工作流编排器（例如 Netflix Conductor 和 Maestro）把所需输入发送给特定服务，并收集输出，以所需格式传递给其他服务。输出可以像小型元数据一样简单，也可以是一个大文件；工作流编排器据此决定如何把数据共享给其他服务。例如，大文件可以转储到 S3，然后把 URL 共享给相应服务。

Page 559

The video distribution services take the encoded videos, apply the packaging, and store them to S3. The videos only make sense if they are combined; this data is maintained in a manifest stored in a metadata database, such as Cassandra or DynamoDB. The cache management service has the responsibility of distributing the data to users’ nearby locations and continuously monitoring the correctness and health of the CDN instances (OCAs, in Netflix’s case). Developing and deploying an architecture similar to Netflix-managed OCAs can bring with it a lot of operational overhead, and we recommend looking into cloud offerings like Amazon CloudFront for content caching. CloudFront is deployed at AWS-managed edge locations in all the major cities and is used by a lot of customers in the media industry.

视频分发服务接收编码后的视频，应用打包，并将其存储到 S3。视频只有组合起来才有意义；这份数据维护在一个清单中，存储在 Cassandra 或 DynamoDB 等元数据数据库里。缓存管理服务负责把数据分发到用户附近位置，并持续监控 CDN 实例（在 Netflix 的情况下是 OCA）的正确性和健康状况。开发和部署类似 Netflix 自建 OCA 的架构会带来大量运维开销，我们建议看看 Amazon CloudFront 等云产品来做内容缓存。CloudFront 部署在 AWS 托管的边缘位置，遍布所有主要城市，被媒体行业的许多客户使用。

Origin Shield is another feature offered as part of CloudFront to improve its caching capabilities. As the name suggests, Origin Shield is an additional layer (or shield) in the front of the origin storage, which is helpful for improving the cache hit ratio and reducing the load on the origin. The first points of contact for users via CloudFront are the edge locations, or PoPs. If data is not cached at the edge locations, the request tries to retrieve data from regional caches—also called regional edge caches (RECs)—and finally from the origin if data is missing at the RECs as well. Once the origin shield is introduced, it acts as the caching layer between the origin and other RECs so that if the data is not cached at an REC, it is retrieved from the origin shield, as shown

Origin Shield 是 CloudFront 提供的另一项功能，用于改善其缓存能力。顾名思义，Origin Shield 是源站存储前面的一个额外层（或盾牌），有助于提高缓存命中率并降低源站负载。用户通过 CloudFront 接触的第一站是边缘位置，或称 PoP（接入点）。如果数据没有缓存在边缘位置，请求会尝试从区域缓存（也称区域边缘缓存，REC）获取数据；如果 REC 上也没有数据，最后才从源站获取。一旦引入 origin shield，它就充当源站与其他 REC 之间的缓存层，这样如果数据没有缓存在某个 REC 上，就从 origin shield 取回，如图

Page 560

in Figure 20-7. In a nutshell, the frequently accessed data from the users (the video chunks) is cached at the edge locations, and users are served upon request.

20-7 所示。简而言之，用户频繁访问的数据（视频块）缓存在边缘位置，用户在请求时获得服务。

Let’s think more about high-traffic scenarios for content consumption. Streaming video content from an edge location to the user’s location consumes a lot of internet bandwidth, and if the number of users is too large, the high traffic can cause network congestion. Network congestion can lead to degradation in video quality. An architecture like OCAs helps take the content one step closer to the user’s location. There are two other steps we can take to avoid network-congestion scenarios:

让我们进一步思考内容消费中的高流量场景。把视频内容从边缘位置流式传输到用户位置会消耗大量互联网带宽；如果用户数量过大，高流量可能导致网络拥塞。网络拥塞会导致视频质量下降。像 OCA 这样的架构有助于把内容再向用户位置拉近一步。我们还可以采取另外两个步骤来避免网络拥塞场景：

  • Work with ISPs so that their internal networks are scaled enough and high traffic requirements don’t create network congestion inside their networks.
    与 ISP 合作，使其内部网络有足够的扩展能力，高流量需求不会在其网络内部造成网络拥塞。
  • Deploy caching appliances inside the ISPs’ networks. The video content is cached on the caching appliances and streamed to user devices on request. This architecture really helps in huge live streaming events: the backend system essentially sends a single stream to the ISP, and then the ISP fans it out to all the connected devices.
    在 ISP 网络内部署缓存设备。视频内容缓存在缓存设备上，并在请求时流式传输到用户设备。这种架构在大型直播事件中非常有帮助：后端系统本质上只向 ISP 发送一路流，然后由 ISP 把它扇出到所有连接的设备。

The video streams up to the CloudFront edge locations and are delivered on a dedicated AWS backbone network away from usual internet traffic—making them much faster—and then a dedicated peering connection can be established with the ISPs to avoid any network congestion. CloudFront also launched embedded PoPs to directly cache the content at the ISPs’ facilities similar to Netflix-managed OCAs. The embedded PoPs are designed to have low power consumption and 128 TB of storage per appliance, and they offer high throughput of up to 70 Gbps.

视频流上传到 CloudFront 边缘位置，并在一条远离常规互联网流量的专用 AWS 骨干网上投递——这使它们快得多——然后可以与 ISP 建立专用对等连接，以避免任何网络拥塞。CloudFront 还推出了嵌入式 PoP（embedded PoP），直接在 ISP 的设施处缓存内容，类似于 Netflix 自建的 OCA。嵌入式 PoP 被设计为低功耗，每台设备 128 TB 存储，并提供高达 70 Gbps 的高吞吐。

One of the important aspects for application deployment and management is monitoring—this is needed from Day 0 to ensure good system health. We have touched on

应用部署与运维的重要方面之一是监控——从 Day 0 起就需要它来确保系统健康。我们已经谈到

Page 561

using Amazon CloudWatch and its features for managing application logs, metrics, and alerts. The architecture presented in Figure 20-6 consists of multiple microservices, and problems can occur in any of them. An orchestration system like AWS Step Functions helps with figuring out the exact step where the state machine failed using error messages.

使用 Amazon CloudWatch 及其功能来管理应用日志、指标和告警。图 20-6 所示的架构由多个微服务组成，任何一个都可能出问题。像 AWS Step Functions 这样的编排系统，能借助错误信息帮助你找出状态机究竟在哪一步失败。

With respect to the general architecture of systems, the request to a front-facing application can span multiple systems in the distributed environment to gather a response. Proper request tracing in a distributed environment makes debugging issues easier and faster. This becomes very important when we want to figure out any streaming issues later down the line—the engineers will need to debug multiple services, making it very difficult to coordinate across the teams. We can use tools like AWS X-Ray, Zipkin, and OpenTracing to trace the application requests in a distributed system architecture. The key design principle in implementing distributed tracing is using the same request ID (a unique identifier to process a request received by service) across the applications. An application should pass the request ID as part of headers, and the receiving service should use it for processing the request.

就系统的一般架构而言，发往前置应用的请求可能会横跨分布式环境中的多个系统才能汇集出一个响应。在分布式环境中做好请求追踪，能让问题调试更容易、更快捷。当我们之后想要弄清任何流式传输问题时，这一点变得非常重要——工程师将需要调试多个服务，跨团队协调会非常困难。我们可以使用 AWS X-Ray、Zipkin 和 OpenTracing 等工具，在分布式系统架构中追踪应用请求。实现分布式追踪的关键设计原则是：在各应用之间使用同一个请求 ID（用于处理服务所接收请求的唯一标识符）。应用应当把请求 ID 作为 header 的一部分传递，接收服务应当使用它来处理请求。

Day N Architecture

We’ll expand on the ideas in the previous section to get a view of the deployment of microservices in the AWS cloud. The architecture of the video-processing pipeline will be similar to the architectures discussed in Chapter 15, using AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the workflows with an additional video-upload component to trigger the workflow. Let’s expand the architecture from Figure 20-6 with the following steps for end-to-end orchestration on AWS:

我们将扩展上一节中的想法，以呈现微服务在 AWS 云上的部署视图。视频处理流水线的架构将类似于第 15 章讨论的架构，使用 AWS Step Functions 编排工作流，并增加一个视频上传组件来触发工作流。让我们用以下步骤扩展图 20-6 的架构，以在 AWS 上进行端到端编排：

  1. Content production houses upload videos via the video upload service, which saves the video file to S3.
    内容制片方通过视频上传服务上传视频，该服务把视频文件保存到 S3。
  2. Upload completion on S3 triggers the Step Functions workflow to invoke a series of microservices to perform specific actions. The event trigger can be configured using Amazon EventBridge on S3 “object created” actions.
    S3 上上传完成会触发 Step Functions 工作流，调用一系列微服务执行特定动作。事件触发器可以使用 Amazon EventBridge 在 S3 的“对象创建”动作上配置。
  3. The first service invoked is the video inspection service, and then other services, such as the complexity analysis and video encoding services, are invoked as described previously. The output of these services is used as a trigger point for invoking the next service.
    第一个被调用的服务是视频检查服务，然后如前所述调用其他服务，例如复杂度分析服务和视频编码服务。这些服务的输出被用作调用下一个服务的触发点。

Figure 20-8 shows all the microservices of the video-processing pipeline in a single EKS cluster. The diagram shows a simple deployment representation for clarity, but the service EKS Pods are deployed in different AZs with autoscaling enabled to ensure the reliability and availability of

图 20-8 展示了单个 EKS 集群中视频处理流水线的所有微服务。对于选择独立 EKS 集群还是单一集群，并没有硬性建议；它在很大程度上取决于规模、隔离需求和合规约束等因素，如第 14 章所讨论。为清晰起见，图中展示的是一个简单的部署表示，但服务的 EKS Pod 实际部署在不同 AZ 中，并启用了自动扩缩容，以确保系统的可靠性和可用性。

the system. Considering Netflix or YouTube’s scale for content production, we recommend hosting separate EKS clusters because they will be owned by independent teams and this will ensure maximum resource separation.

考虑到 Netflix 或 YouTube 那样的内容生产规模，我们建议托管独立的 EKS 集群，因为它们将由独立团队拥有，这能确保最大程度的资源隔离。

Another paradigm followed for the EKS deployments is creating separate namespaces to deploy the services. Creating different namespaces gives a clear boundary for

EKS 部署遵循的另一种范式是创建独立的命名空间来部署服务。创建不同的命名空间为服务所使用的资源隔离提供了清晰的边界，

Conclusion

This chapter discussed the architecture of video-processing or ingestion systems for platforms that produce online content, such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, and YouTube. The most important takeaway from our review of the overall architecture, which should be applied as a general principle for architecting any new system, is fail-fast behavior. If the system can identify issues at the earliest stage possible, that reduces the touchpoints in the overall system and makes debugging much faster. We’ve implemented quality checks in all stages of the video-processing pipeline to ensure optimal quality of video.

本章讨论了 Netflix、Amazon Prime Video 和 YouTube 等在线内容生产平台的视频处理或摄入系统架构。我们回顾整体架构后最重要的收获，应当作为架构任何新系统的通用原则加以应用的，就是快速失败（fail-fast）行为。如果系统能在尽可能早的阶段发现问题，就能减少整个系统中的接触点，并让调试快得多。我们在视频处理流水线的所有阶段都实现了质量检查，以确保视频的最优质量。

In Chapter 1, we discussed fallacies in making assumptions about distributed systems, such as infinite network bandwidth availability. Architectures like the video-processing pipeline and content distribution at a large scale lead us to think about these fallacies in more depth. For example, the problem of network congestion is solved by moving content to the user’s nearest possible location and storing it there for distribution.

在第 1 章中，我们讨论了对分布式系统做假设时的谬误，例如假设网络带宽无限可用。像视频处理流水线和大规模内容分发这样的架构，引导我们更深入地思考这些谬误。例如，网络拥塞问题是通过把内容移动到离用户尽可能近的位置、并在那里存储以备分发来解决的。

This chapter introduced you to an asynchronous, event-driven system where execution latency to the milliseconds level is important but not critical. In the next chapter, we’ll explore the architecture of an online stock-trading application, which is a real-time, latency-critical system.

本章向你介绍了一个异步、事件驱动的系统，其中毫秒级的执行延迟很重要，但并非关键。下一章我们将探索一个在线股票交易应用的架构，那是一个实时、延迟关键（latency-critical）的系统。
